predecessors.name: Kingdom of Mrauk U
predecessors.text: Syriam (Thanlyin) and its district at the mouth of the Pegu river; the pages describe only 'the city'

successors.name: Toungoo Empire
successors.text: Syriam (Thanlyin) and its district at the mouth of the Pegu river; the pages describe only 'the city'

ledger.x: 1603: de Brito declares Syriam independent of Arakan.
April 1613: Portuguese Syriam ends with de Brito's execution by impalement ('it took him three days to die').

wars.name: Syriam battles of 1604-1605
wars.outcome: De Brito defeats the Arakanese navy in 1604 and 1605 and captures Crown Prince Min Khamaung; Toungoo's Natshinnaung is later a refugee at Syriam.

wars.name: Burmese siege of Syriam (1613)
wars.outcome: Anaukpetlun takes Syriam in April 1613; de Brito and Natshinnaung are executed.

certainty.note: A fortified port: the pages describe the city, no frontier.
